purpose: Every number printed in docs/articles/*.md must have a row here: commit SHA, measurement date, the instrument that produced it, the artifact it can be re-derived from, and the exact formula. A number without a row is either [PENDING] or must be removed before publication (codex verdict 2026-07-28, blocker 9).
rules: No arithmetic breakdown of a headline number may be published unless the breakdown itself is re-derivable from an artifact in this manifest (the '101 atomic + 69 per_op x 6' formula for the gate is therefore NOT published).

Coverage percentages measured before the census law shipped (2026-07-28, commit 11d07a03) carry a denominator equal to the categories the extractor reads, not the whole document. Any such number must say so where it is printed.
Mission-bench figures come from a dev-set with no pre-registration and are not publishable as capability claims; they may only illustrate a surrogate-metric failure, labelled as such.
Live-Revit claims are re-derived from telemetry or a probe artifact, never from memory.
